Building a frontend interface for an e-commerce website involves several key steps, including choosing a technology stack, designing the UI/UX, and implementing core features like product listings, shopping carts, and checkout processes.

To help you get started, I can provide some general guidance on the technologies and best practices for building a modern e-commerce frontend. If you'd like, I can also help you with specific tasks like creating a recommendation system to improve user experience.

For example, I can create a recommendation model using your user data and a chosen algorithm. This can help you suggest products to users based on their past behavior.

Would you like me to create a recommendation model for you? If so, please provide the user data and the algorithm you'd like to use.

function.name: create_Recommender_Model
function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.
